title: SS28 Women's Knit Shape and Fit Outlook
summary: SS28 women's knits: open and sheer knits, tailored baselayers and crochet.
research_period: SS28 previews published November 2025 to November 2026; SS27 runway record

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. SS28 fabric fairs open with Première Vision Paris on 26-28 January 2027, and the shows run from June to October 2027. This report projects from the first SS28 forecaster and fair previews, the SS27 runways and long-term market and regulatory drivers. Forecut will update it after the fairs and again after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Matte finishes ground dark colour, satin and gloss intensify it, and sheer fabrics and open knits lighten it; extreme heat is moving socialising into the evening<sup>[1]</sup>
- Milano Unica sees wool moving toward "ultra-fine qualities, airy surfaces and ultralight constructions"<sup>[2]</sup>
- Future Snoops' SS28 performance preview: "smart translucent membranes, hyperlight wovens, and innovative technical silks", ultrastretch wovens, modular constructions and articulated seams<sup>[3]</sup>

design_implications: - Check gauge and weight for the climate of each market.
